summary: The target-valid family A_epsilon=[1] direct_sum [[0,H_epsilon],[H_epsilon,0]], H_epsilon=diag(1,1,epsilon), 0<epsilon<=1/200, defeats every one-scale ridge certificate at every regularizer and also fails the current canonical e3 and fractional-e2 volume-sampling marginal gates. The live bicolop source block separately has canonical order-2 and order-3 volume marginals >24/25 at both anchors, so the common-theta volume route is quantitatively incompatible with theta>2/3 there.
